Introduction

S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research (SPJIMR) is committed to protecting the privacy of everyone who visits www.spjimr.org (the ‘website’). This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how SPJIMR uses them, the categories of cookies deployed on the website, and how visitors can manage their cookie preferences.

This policy should be read together with SPJIMR’s Privacy Policy, which explains how SPJIMR collects, uses and protects personal data more broadly. Where there is a conflict between the two, the Privacy Policy governs the treatment of personal data, and this Cookie Policy governs the specific use of cookies and similar tracking technologies.

What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that a website stores on a visitor’s device (computer, tablet or mobile) when the website loads in a browser. Cookies help a website function properly, remain secure, remember visitor preferences, and understand how visitors use the site so that SPJIMR can improve it.

Cookies may be ‘session’ cookies, which are deleted once the browser is closed, or ‘persistent’ cookies, which remain on the device for a set period or until manually deleted. Cookies may also be ‘first-party’ (set by spjimr.org directly) or ‘third-party’ (set by another domain whose content or service is embedded on the website, such as YouTube or Google).

How SPJIMR uses cookies

Like most institutional websites, spjimr.org uses a mix of first-party and third-party cookies for the following purposes:

  • Necessary functionality: Enabling core features such as secure browsing, page navigation, and remembering cookie consent choices.
  • Functional performance: Enabling features such as social media sharing, embedded videos, and third-party widgets.
  • Analytics: Understanding how visitors use the website, including pages visited, time spent, and navigation patterns, so that SPJIMR can improve site content and design.
  • Advertising and outreach: Measuring and, where applicable, personalising promotional content related to SPJIMR’s programmes.

SPJIMR does not use cookies to collect sensitive personal data, and first-party cookies used for core functionality do not collect personally identifiable information.

Legal basis for use of cookies

SPJIMR’s use of cookies is governed by the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), and, to the extent applicable, the Information Technology Act, 2000, read with the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.

Cookies that are strictly necessary for the website to function are deployed without requiring separate consent, as they are essential to providing the service the visitor has requested. All other categories of cookies (functional, analytics, and advertising) are deployed only after the visitor provides explicit, informed consent via the cookie consent banner on the first visit.

Visitors may withdraw consent at any time, with the same ease with which it was given, through the ‘Consent Preferences’ option described in Section 7 below. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of cookie use prior to withdrawal.

Third-party cookies and data sharing

Certain cookies on spjimr.org are set by third-party services embedded on the website, including Google (reCAPTCHA, YouTube), Cloudflare, Elfsight, and CookieYes. These third parties may process data collected through their cookies in accordance with their own privacy policies, which SPJIMR encourages visitors to review.

SPJIMR does not sell personal data collected through cookies to any third party. SPJIMR shares information with third-party service providers only to the extent necessary for them to perform the services for which they are engaged, such as website security, content delivery, and consent management.

Managing your cookie preferences

Visitors can update or withdraw their cookie consent at any time by selecting ‘Consent Preferences’ on the website, which reopens the cookie consent banner and allows preferences to be changed for each cookie category.

Visitors can also manage or delete cookies directly through their browser settings. Disabling or deleting cookies may affect the functionality of some parts of the website. Guidance for common browsers is available at the links below:

  • Google Chrome
  • Safari
  • Mozilla Firefox
  • Microsoft Edge / Internet Explorer

Visitors using a different browser should refer to that browser’s official support documentation.

Children’s data

SPJIMR’s website is not directed at children, and SPJIMR does not knowingly collect personal data from minors through cookies without verifiable parental or guardian consent, where such consent is required by applicable law. A parent or guardian who believes their child has provided personal data through the website should contact SPJIMR using the details in Section 10.

Changes to this policy

SPJIMR may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies used on the website, technology, or applicable law. Material changes will be reflected in the ‘Last updated’ date at the top of this page, and, where required by law, visitors will be asked to reconfirm their consent.

Contact us

For any questions about this Cookie Policy, or to exercise rights available under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, visitors may contact SPJIMR at:

S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research, Bhavan’s Campus, Munshi Nagar, Andheri West, Mumbai – 400 058 Email: info@spjimr.org

This policy reflects the cookies identified in SPJIMR’s most recent website cookie scan, restructured to align with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the DPDP Rules, 2025, Notified.
